alerts.title: Frost Advisory issued October 31 at 1:26AM EDT until November 1 at 8:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
alerts.area: Salem; Gloucester; Camden; Cumberland; Cape May; Eastern Chester; Eastern Montgomery; Lower Bucks
alerts.description: * WHAT...Temperatures as low as 34 degrees will result in areas of frost formation. * WHERE...In New Jersey, Camden, Cape May, Cumberland, Gloucester, and Salem Counties. In Pennsylvania, Eastern Chester, Eastern Montgomery, and Lower Bucks Counties. * WHEN...From midnight EDT tonight to 8 AM EST Sunday. * IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
alerts.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
